trigger: P0576 selected both p=1.5 and f_alpha=1 at the upper boundaries while improving held-out raw-family scatter by 44.8%.
question: Does the long-wavelength response have an interior optimum beyond p=1.5, and does one locked exponent remain useful across every source-family partition?
formula: Identical to P0576: ordinary local field plus Q90-gated routed field multiplied by (k/k0)^(2*(1-p)), k0=2*pi/(60 kpc).

selection.rule: Choose minimum calibration-family source-plane RMS; apply the one selected p and f to held-out families without refitting either coordinate.
selection.postselection_robustness: With p and f locked, enumerate all six two-family amplitude-calibration partitions; only the single overall amplitude is refitted in each partition.

claim_limits: The extension reuses the same SMACS J0723 raw positions, and p=1.5 has already touched the held-out families.
Split robustness is within-cluster reuse, not external validation.
A fitted overall amplitude remains, so absolute strength is not predicted.
Only the routed angular component changes; galaxy rotation remains unexplained and exactly unchanged.
